artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Leandro Bassano
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people surrounding a central figure. The central figure is seated and bare-chested, with a cloth covering the lower body. The individuals around the central figure are in various positions such as kneeling or standing, some with hands in a pose of prayer. They have distinct facial features and wear historically styled clothing. Some individuals wear accessories like hats or scarves. The background features large columns and a landscape with trees and buildings. The image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Water Mill
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with a view from an elevated perspective showing a village nestled among hilly terrain. The horizon is high in the composition, creating a sense of depth. To the left, a mountain with a castle-like structure on top can be seen. The etching employs precise lines to depict the natural foliage and architecture, including trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray typical of an etching. Closest to us, there is a waterway with a bridge, and beyond that, the village with half-timbered houses, a mill, and surrounding hills extending towards a mountainous backdrop.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve after Their Expulsion from Paradise
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures in a natural setting. On the left, there is an elderly bearded man walking barefoot and carrying a large, cross-like object slung over his shoulder. He is dressed in a fur garment. A bird perches on his back. Next to him is a woman cradling a baby against her chest. She has long, flowing hair and wears a long gown. Both figures are surrounded by stones and sparse plant life. In the background stands a bare, twisted tree, its branches stark against the blank background.

artworks.title: Joseph Interprets the Dreams of the Pharaoh
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a group of figures in an interior setting. The scene shows individuals gathered around a table set with a cup and a plate. The figures are dressed in historical clothing. The drawing includes detailed elements like clothing folds, tablecloth texture, and architectural features. The figures display various postures and expressions suggesting interaction or a narrative. The setting includes columns and decorative carvings, providing depth and historical context.

artworks.title: Entablatures from Santa Pudenziana and the Arch of Camigliano, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements of the Corinthian order. The drawing showcases detailed sections of Corinthian capitals with precise measurements and annotations written in Latin. The intricate designs feature typical Corinthian acanthus leaves and ornaments, highlighting the classic order's decorative elements. It appears as if two sections are outlined, showing plan and elevation views, with highly detailed drawing techniques to convey their volumetric form. The measurements are carefully marked along the side. The text provides further context.

artworks.title: Entablature from the Basilica Ulpia, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural details of a Corinthian column. The drawing provides a depiction of the intricate design elements of Corinthian architecture, with measurements and annotations. The image focuses on the capitals and entablature of the column, showcasing the acanthus leaves and volutes typical of the Corinthian order. The drawing includes measurements and Latin inscriptions, suggesting instructional or reference purposes. The layout is technical, with a focus on proportional accuracy and detailing.

artworks.title: Entablature from the Church of Saint Bibiana, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural details of a Corinthian order. The illustration features multiple views of the capital design characteristic of the Corinthian style, known for its acanthus leaves and scroll patterns. The drawing includes measurements and annotations, highlighting the focus on the proportional and decorative elements of the structure. The lines are fine and detailed, suggesting it served an educational or planning purpose for architects or artists studying classical architecture.

artworks.title: Entablature from the Temple of Castor and Pollux, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural Corinthian capital. The drawing depicts a detailed section of a classical Corinthian column with an emphasis on its intricate capital. The column is adorned with acanthus leaves and scrolls. Measurements and annotations in Latin are included alongside the drawings, which are labeled to provide insight into the structural proportions of the capital. The text at the bottom reads "CORINTHIA," and further notations appear to describe dimension specifics. The drawing aims to document the architecture of the Corinthian order.

artworks.title: Entablature from the Temple of Antoninus and Faustina, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural column detail. The drawing presents a detailed technical study of a Corinthian column capital. The design features include carvings of acanthus leaves and volutes, characteristic of the Corinthian order. The image includes a schematic representation with measurements marked. There is attention to the decoration, including a winged creature. The annotations in the drawing are written in Latin.

artworks.title: Capitals from the Baths of Antoninus, Rome
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a Corinthian column capital. The illustration features an ornate Corinthian capital with acanthus leaves and scrolls, depicted with line work and shading. Below the capital is Latin text, including the word "CORINTHIO" and other notations.

artworks.title: Entablature from the Temple of Vespasian, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural order. The drawing shows detailed architectural elements of a Corinthian column with precise measurements and annotations. The drawing depicts a stylized column capital adorned with ornate foliage and scroll motifs typical of the Corinthian order. Detailed lines and shading give a three-dimensional effect to the decorative elements, including acanthus leaves and scrollwork. Lion heads are carved in relief, embellishing the frieze area. The overall composition is laid out with precise notations, indicating dimensions and proportional relationships, likely for an architectural or educational purpose. Latin text is inscribed, providing additional context about the drawing, including the title 'CORINTHIA.'

artworks.title: Capital from the Colosseum, Rome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural capital in the Corinthian style. The artwork shows a Corinthian capital ornamented with acanthus leaves and scrollwork, detailed with etching lines. Florid embellishments are featured. The drawing includes measurements and Latin inscriptions. The text and borders contribute to its historical and educational context.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Andrew
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up. The man on the left has a short, curly beard, and wavy hair that falls to his ears. The other man has longer, slightly wavy hair and no beard. Both men have halos around their heads. They are wearing robes. The man on the left holds a large key and a book, while the man on the right holds several books. The background features intricate carvings resembling branches and leaves framing their heads. Both figures are in front of a wooden panel with detailed carvings. There is an inscription in Gothic-style lettering at the bottom.

artworks.title: Couronnement de Voltaire (The Crowning of Voltaire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance in an archway setting. The full representation portrays an elaborate scene featuring an ornate stage set within a grand, architectural backdrop with large arches. The drawing captures detailed architectural elements, including rows of arches and a panel of columns, framing the performance area. The balconies are filled with onlookers observing the scene. The performers on stage are dressed in elaborate costumes, suggestive of a historical or classical drama. The audience below the stage also showcases intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Couronnement de Voltaire (The Crowning of Voltaire)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance in an ornate architectural setting. The scene shows figures in elaborate 18th-century attire on a stage, with a backdrop of arches and columns. The audience is depicted in balconies surrounding the stage. The drawing includes detailed textures for clothing and architecture, with a framed border emphasizing its theatrical nature.

artworks.title: Couronnement de Voltaire (The Crowning of Voltaire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical tribute to Voltaire. The scene is set in a classical theatre with intricate architectural details. The audience is gathered in balconies to witness figures presenting a homage at the bust of Voltaire. The arches, columns, and costumes are detailed and grand. The composition features figures on either side of the bust, creating symmetry and formality. The artwork captures a moment of celebration and respect, with rich textures and meticulous details.

artworks.title: Mirabeau arrive aux Champs-Élisées
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a wooded landscape. The scene shows individuals in historical attire surrounded by lush trees and bushes. In the foreground, a figure is seated on a bench alongside a small lyre. Nearby, a small figure can be seen holding what appears to be a laurel wreath. The setting suggests a picturesque glade with a body of water being navigated by a boatman. The intricate detailing of foliage in the trees, the clothing, and the expressions of the figures convey a sense of movement and commemoration.

artworks.title: Mirabeau arrive aux Champs-Élisées
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering in a lush forested area, where heavenly figures are present. The scene is a complex composition featuring various individuals amidst a natural setting bordered by large trees. One figure seated on stylized architectural elements appears to be presenting a document to others in a gathering. A winged cherub-like figure is flying above, holding a crown and a banner. The group also includes several other figures who seem to be engaged in discussion, while in the background, more people are depicted as if they are listening or watching the ongoing proceedings. The drawing's intricate details, particularly in the rendering of the trees and foliage, enhance the overall richness of the setting.

artworks.title: Mirabeau arrive aux Champs-Élisées
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a gathering of historical figures in a wooded landscape. The image shows various historical figures in a clearing surrounded by trees. A central figure gestures towards another figure on a small boat to the right. A cherub flies in the sky above holding a banner with the inscription "LA FRANCE LIBRE" ("Free France"). The ground is covered with scrolls and papers, and in the background, other figures observe the scene. The foliage and expressions of the figures suggest a historical or allegorical narrative.

artworks.title: Interior of a Barn with a Peasant Woman at Work
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper

artworks.title: Christ Surrounded by Children
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures, including full views of two adults in the center and partial views of other adults and children. The central figure, a bearded man with shoulder-length hair and a radiant glow around his head, is holding a small child. Surrounding him are several women, also standing, one holding an infant. The women wear long-sleeve dresses with high collars. There are also children present, one holding a sword. The background shows an exterior setting with large columns and an open space leading to a landscape with trees and a church with a steeple.

artworks.title: Grammar
artworks.description: The illustration portrays two figures. One figure is a seated woman, shown from head to feet with her body slightly turned to the right. Her hair is styled with waves and appears tied back. She wears a classical dress and holds a key against her left shoulder with her left hand. Standing next to her is a small, winged child-like figure holding a rectangular board displaying the alphabet. The background includes textured walls and stone-like structures, one of which the woman is seated on, with an inscription reading "ACITAM MARG." The setting suggests an antique or classical scene.

artworks.title: Dialectic
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a seated woman on the right and a full-body view of a winged cherub standing beside her on the left. The woman is positioned in profile, facing left, with her legs crossed and her upper body leaning slightly forward. She has classical facial features and her hair is styled back, adorned with a laurel wreath. Her clothing is a draped classical gown, cinched at the waist, and there is fabric resting on her knees. She is holding a scroll in her left hand. The cherub is holding a large pair of compasses and a set of scales, and stands beside the woman on the ground. The background features simple architectural elements and the words "DIALECTICA" and a monogram "P C" appear in the top left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Rhetoric
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a stone structure or bench. She is leaning slightly forward with her head bent down, looking to the side. Her facial features are defined, with a notable nose and a contemplative expression. She has curly hair tied back, with a few strands framing her face. She is dressed in a flowing garment with detailed folds and a cinched waist. Beside her on the bench are books and a small figure resembling a cherub. The background features a textured wall and an open window or alcove. The word "RHETORICA" is inscribed in the upper left corner.
